The Critter Safari is a Hunting Location accessible from the  Torrhus Canyon. After reaching  Hunting XV (15), it can be accessed by speaking to the Safari Manager using Safari Tickets, which are obtained from Miria's Starlyn Contests.

Accessing

[edit | edit source]

The Critter Safari can be accessed from the Safari Manager using Safari Tickets. These come in multiple varieties, obtained from Miria's Contests.

  • Basic Safari Ticket: Unlocks the Basic Safari Experience. The player starts with  32 Critter Capsules.
  • Economy Safari Ticket: Unlocks the Economy Safari Experience. The player starts with  40 Critter Capsules and gains +10%  Safari Essence and +5 ☯ Hunting Wisdom.
  • Premium Safari Ticket: Unlocks the Premium Safari Experience. The player starts with  48 Critter Capsules and gains +25%  Safari Essence and +15 ☯ Hunting Wisdom.
  • First-Class Safari Ticket: Unlocks the First-Class Safari Experience. The player starts with  56 Critter Capsules, gains +50%  Safari Essence, +25 ☯ Hunting Wisdom, and gains a random Quest Item upon entering the Critter Safari.

Higher tiers of Safari Tickets are obtained from reaching higher brackets in Miria's Contest.

When the player runs out of  Critter Capsules, they are given the option to leave the Critter Safari.

Biomes

[edit | edit source]

The Critter Safari is split into 4 biomes: the Cavern, Forest, Haunted, and Icy biomes. Each biome has their own sets of Critters, Floor Drops, and mechanics.

Floor Drops can be found on the ground, marked by  String. They will grant either  Safari Essence,  Hunting XP, a shard, or a random Quest Item, which can be used throughout the Critter Safari to interact with the map.

Cavern

[edit | edit source]

The Cavern biome consists of a large cavern system that stretches into the bowels of the map, with large veins of  Raw Gold, carts full of ores, and mining platforms.

The following Critters can be hunted here: Cavernfish, Flitter, Shyworm, Driftling, Chuckwalla, Rockmite, Scrappy, Snoozle, and Gemzie.

Forest

[edit | edit source]

The Forest biome consists of a sprawling network of trees and a small underground cave system.

The following Critters can be hunted here: Foxtrot, Bluebird, Honeybug, Treefrog, Woodchucker, Fluffling, Hideonfloor, Parakeet, and Macaw.

The Forest also contains the Birdfeeder, which allows players to summon the Bluebird, Parakeet, or Macaw using foods found from Floor Drops found throughout the Forest biome. Different foods buff different bird chances.

The Birdfeeder can be found at  -1, 90, 44.

Haunted

[edit | edit source]

The Haunted biome consists of a large haunted mansion and a small underground cave to spawn the Doomspiral.

The following Critters can be hunted here: Areita, Bloodbat, Duplico, Gazer, Litterbug, Solsnatcher, Gimmiegold, Hideonwall, Hideyho, and Doomspiral.

Icy

[edit | edit source]

The Icy biome features the same  Cold mechanic from the  Glacite Tunnels. This can be decreased while near campfires.  Cold Resistance applies in the Icy biome, and being in water will cause  Cold to increment faster.

The following Critters can be hunted here: Strongarm, Tepid, Polaris, Shuddersquid, Billygoat, Mantis Shrimp, Nozzlenose, Troodon, and Wumpa.

Condition Game Message
Reaching -25  Cold BRRR! It's getting really cold in here! But you've got to keep moving...
Reaching -50  Cold BRRR! It's so cold that you can barely feel your fingers. Moving is getting difficult...
Reaching -75  Cold BRRR! Your movement slows to a crawl as the cold threatens to take over. Time to get out of here...
The following title also appears:
FROSTBITE!

Find warmth before you freeze to death...

Reaching -90  Cold BRRR! You're freezing! All you can think about is getting out of here to a warm campfire...
Reaching -100  Cold and dying, in the Icy biome of the  Critter Safari You fainted and lost some of your items!

Critters

[edit | edit source]

37 Critters are native to the Critter Safari, with 10 Critters being found in the Haunted biome and 9 Critters being found in the others. They can only be hunted with  Critter Capsules, which are thrown at Critters. Regular Hunting Tools, such as Huntaxes, Black Holes, Lassos, and Fishing Nets are disabled in the Critter Safari: if the player ever finds a way to have a Hunting Tool in their inventory, it will be automatically sent to the Stash.

The higher the rarity of the Shard dropped by the player's desired Critter, the lower the chance to successfully capture the Critter.

Critter Rarity Successful Catch Chance Hard Pity[1]
COMMON 100% (1 in 1) 1
UNCOMMON 75% (1 in 1.33) 2
RARE 50% (1 in 2) 3
EPIC 25% (1 in 4) 5
LEGENDARY 5% (1 in 20) 20

If a critter is caught, every player in the Critter Safari receives the shard and progress towards Safari Milestones, but not the Critterdex.

Each Critter has a Uniqueness Score, granting +5,000  Hunting XP for each Critter caught, up to +185,000  Hunting XP without Floor Drops or ☯ Hunting Wisdom being factored in.

❣ Charm Chance does not affect the Critter Safari.

Sparkling Critters

[edit | edit source]

SPARKLING Critters have a 1/4,096 chance to replace any Critter in the Critter Safari. SPARKLING Critters are telegraphed with orange particles and a SPARKLING tag in their name, alongside wind chimes playing when nearby.


SPARKLING Critters drop 10x of their regular drops, alongside a  Rainbow Feather, with a 25% chance of dropping another with the Splendor attribute. Additionally, SPARKLING Critters also have a 100x chance to drop an  Emerald Dye.

Condition Game Message
Capturing a SPARKLING Critter
-------------------------------------------
SPARKLING! <player> caught a SPARKLING <critter>!
-------------------------------------------
CAPTURE! You caught a SPARKLING <critter> and received a Rainbow Feather and #x <shard>!
Lootsharing a SPARKLING Critter
-------------------------------------------
SPARKLING! <player> caught a SPARKLING <critter>!
-------------------------------------------
LOOT SHARE! You received a Rainbow Feather and #x <shard> from <player> catching a SPARKLING <critter>!

Catching SPARKLING Critters contributes to the Sparkling Critterdex, which is unlocked after completing the Critterdex and grants cosmetic rewards as an optional grind. The Sparkling Critterdex does not grant SkyBlock XP. Unlike the normal Critterdex, captures will unlock the Sparkling Critterdex entry for all players in the lobby.

The chances of spawning SPARKLING Critters can be increased by 2x with a  Sparkling Amulet: the player will spawn with one equipped if they have the Sparkling Specialist perk active, which can be purchased from Archie for  10,000 Safari Essence. The bonus of the  Sparkling Amulet does not stack.

Quest Items

[edit | edit source]

Quest Items are SPECIAL items found around the Critter Safari that are used to interact with the environment, usually leading to exclusive Shards that the player otherwise would not be able to access.

Floor Drops

[edit | edit source]
Main article: Floor Drops

A limited number of Floor Drops will appear throughout the different biomes in the Critter Safari: they do not respawn. Floor Drops may contain Quest Items,  Safari Essence,  Hunting XP, or a Shard.

Harvestable Resources

[edit | edit source]

Players can harvest  Wholesale Wheat, punch fish to get  Flavor-packed Fish, and break lily pads to get  Lush Lily Pads. These resources can be found and used in the Cavern biome.

Safari Belt

[edit | edit source]
Main article: Safari Belt

The  Safari Belt is the only item outside the Critter Safari the player may bring with them. It increments in rarity and stats depending on their Safari Milestones, which can be viewed at Andrea.

  • Successful hunts in the Cavern biome grant ☯ Hunting Wisdom and increases its rarity.
  • Successful hunts in the Forest biome grant  Foraging Fortune.
  • Successful hunts in the Haunted biome grant  Hunting Fortune.
  • Successful hunts in the Icy biome grant  Cold Resistance.

Hunting Hotspot

[edit | edit source]

If the player has the Hunting Hotspot perk unlocked at Archie, a random biome will be selected as the player's Hunting Hotspot. While in a Hunting Hotspot, the player gains +5-25  Hunting Fortune.

Bells

[edit | edit source]

There are 7  Bells scattered around the Critter Safari at different locations. Upon finding all 7  Bells and returning to "Hunter" Tobias, a cutscene begins to play. For the sake of spoilers, the following section will be hidden.

Show/Hide Bell Coordinates

  •  -68, 66, -43: A  Bell is hidden on the bottom of an ice platform near the entrance to the Icy biome. Jumping on the platform repeatedly will cause it to flip over, yielding the What the flip?! secret achievement. The bell will be too cold to ring, requiring an  Icebreaker to break it.
  •  -96, 46, -57: A  Bell is hidden behind a bed found in an underground cavern in the underwater lake in the Icy biome.
  •  -4, 96, -42: A  Bell is hidden on the roof of the mansion in the Haunted biome. It can be accessed from parkour from the bottom of the mansion, or from climbing to the top of the Icy biome and jumping into the roof.
  •  47, 55, -7: A  Bell is hidden at the edge of the Critter Safari, accessed from the Forest biome waterfalls, before dropping down and walking towards the Haunted biome while on the outer rim of the Critter Safari. The ledge can be exited safely by ascending from the vine at  16, 53, 79.
  •  -30, 125, 59: A  Bell is hidden near the top of the Forest biome, requiring parkour across a large tree to a floating island.
  •  -90, 109, 16: A  Bell is hidden at the top of the Cavern biome: you will need to climb from a fake cactus onto a large stack from  -138, 102, 26, parkour across a tree, and make it to another stack where the bell is found.
  •  -50, 81, 0: A  Bell is hidden at the top of the landing zone, accessible from an ice spike by the entrance to the Icy biome.

Each bell corresponds to a specific color in the rainbow. Completing the rainbow and returning to the landing zone yields the following dialogue from "Hunter" Tobias:

[NPC] "Hunter" Tobias: Uh guys, you better come and see this...

Finally, a cutscene plays as the player walks into the landing zone. As the player looks at the rainbow, the following dialogue plays:

Wow, a rainbow. I haven't seen one of them in a long time. Isn't it beautiful?
You know, there are so many memories in a rainbow.
I remember seeing one while playing with all my friends, back when we were very small.
The next time I saw one was many years later, after one of them died.
Sometimes it feels like, every time I see one, there are less of my kind left to see it with me.
But it's still oddly comforting.
Before I was here, there were rainbows.
After I am gone, there will still be rainbows.
Throughout my short life, everything I once knew has changed beyond recognition.
As for the rainbows, I don't think they notice the difference.

With each dialogue, the player's Miracle Chance attribute gains +1 level, maxing out upon the cutscene ending. Players also receive The Miracle in a sunbeam secret achievement.

During this cutscene, a custom song plays:

Tips

[edit | edit source]
  • Never enter the Critter Safari solo. Almost everything except for regular Critterdex progress and  Emerald Dyes is shared. Additionally, more players allow for a faster run. It is usually recommended to have at least 3 players, preferably 4.
  • In the Safari Essence Shop, Morning Dew and Critter Master are one of the most important upgrades to obtain.
    • The  Morning Dew grants the  Safari Belt 50  Speed while in the Critter Safari, allowing for faster clears, along a handful of stats that are useful within it. It is also currently the only Equipment Reforge that grants  Hunting stats.
    • The  Masterful Critter Capsule has a 100% capture rate. It is best used on the Doomspiral, Wumpa, and, if it spawns, Macaw, which would allow up to 20 capsules to be saved.
      • Players may also wish to use it on a RARE, EPIC or SPARKLING critter if they do not need to capture any of the above  Critter (such as if they are clearing the Cavern biome) or are running low on capsules.
  • There are 2 types of Critter Safari runs: Full Clear and Unique runs.
    • In a Full Clear run, players aim to capture all critters for shards. To effectively do this, it is a good strategy to let each player clear one biome. Hotspots could be used as a reference for allocations.
      • Alternatively, two players could overlap the Cavern biome, one for the upper part and one for the lower, to achieve a faster run. This is because this biome takes the longest to clear by far.
      •  Masterful Critter Capsules are best to used on the Doomspiral, the Wumpa, and the two Macaws if they spawn.
    • In a Unique run, players trade off the amount of shards obtained for the speed of capturing all unique critters. Such runs are the quickest way for grinding  Hunting experience by far.
      • For mobs that are difficult to catch, such as Treefrogs, their duplicate captures are usually discarded for efficiency.
      • The common strategy is to allocate each player to a biome. As the amount of shards is no longer the goal, Hotspots are usually ignored. There would be no need to overlap the Cavern biome.
      • Players may wish to use a  Masterful Critter Capsule on a Gemzie.
  • SPARKLING critters that do not use vanilla textures (such as Shyworm) have custom textures when they spawn that differ from their normal texture. This can be used to determine if critters such as Troodon and Hideyho are SPARKLING before interacting with them, as they do not have name tags before being interacted with.
  • Usually it is better to spend a bit of downtime between runs to get UNCOMMON on Miria's Contest whenever there is a new contest to secure more safari tickets for more runs.
  • Always use a First-Class ticket unless you are hunting only for SPARKLING critters. The additional  Safari Essence will most likely outweigh the cost in upgrading tickets, and the additional ☯ Hunting Wisdom is also nice to have.

Notes

[edit | edit source]
  • Bestiary progress,  Safari Belt Milestones progress, Attribute Shard drops and Sparkling Critterdex entries are shared with everyone in a party — effectively everything except loot obtained from Floor Drops, trading with NPCs and unlocking entries for the regular Critterdex.
    • While Attribute Shard drops are shared, every player's  Hunting Fortune is counted for them individually.
  • The  Hunting XP gain from Critter Safari is affected by ☯ Hunting Wisdom that the player has inside Safari. It is also affected by Derpy's MOAR SKILLZ!!! perk.
  • Unlike with the Catacombs, players who leave the Critter Safari cannot reenter.

Trivia

[edit | edit source]
  • The release of the Critter Safari marks the first time since SkyBlock's release where more than one island has been released in one update.
  • Excluding Gimmiegolds, there are on average 40 critters in the Cavern biome, 33.91 critters in the Forest biome, 33 critters in the Haunted biome and 35 critters in the Icy biome, for a total of 141.91 critters.
    • The chance of getting at least one SPARKLING critter is then approximately 3.4%, raised to 6.6% with a  Sparkling Amulet.
  • A Critter Safari instance will automatically close after around 60 minutes regardless of progress or player activity.
